title: Henselianity descends through a quotient inside the maximal ideal
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a local ring whose maximal-ideal pair is henselian in the idempotent-lifting sense of [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], and let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$. Then the pair $(A/I,\mathfrak m/I)$ is henselian: for every finite $(A/I)$-algebra $B$, every idempotent of $B/(\mathfrak m/I)B$ lifts to a unique idempotent of $B$.

source.place: Lemma 05WS (label lemma-quotient-strict-henselization), line 43703 and its proof
